UNITED INDIA INSURANCE COMPANY
UNITED INDIA INSURANCE COMPANY is the insurance company issuing the Family Medicare Policy.

Proposer
The Proposer is the person who applies for the insurance policy.

Insured
The Insured is the person named in the policy schedule, covered by the insurance.

Insured Persons
The Insured Persons are the individuals named in the policy schedule who are covered by the insurance.

Family Medicare Policy
A type of insurance policy.<SEP>The Family Medicare Policy is a health insurance contract.<SEP>The specific type of health insurance policy offered.

Hospital
A Hospital is an institution for in-patient and day care treatment.

Day Care Centre
A Day Care Centre is an institution for day care treatment.

Medical Practitioner
A Medical Practitioner is a person who holds a valid medical registration and is entitled to practice medicine.

Illness
Illness is a sickness or disease requiring medical treatment.

Injury
Injury is accidental physical bodily harm.

Cashless Facility
A Cashless Facility is a service where payments for treatment are made directly to the provider.

Condition Precedent
A Condition Precedent is a policy term upon which the insurer's liability is conditional.

Congenital Anomaly
Congenital Anomaly refers to a condition present since birth.

Co-payment
Co-payment is a cost-sharing requirement where the insured pays a percentage of the claim.

Deductible
Deductible is a cost-sharing requirement where the insurer is not liable for a specified amount.

Dental Treatment
Dental Treatment refers to treatment related to teeth.

Balloon Sinuplasty
A medical procedure, specifically mentioned in relation to claims and coverage limits.

A medical procedure, specifically mentioned in relation to claims and coverage limits.

Central Nervous System
A body system, mentioned in relation to Robotic Surgeries.

Malignancies
A type of disease, mentioned in relation to Robotic Surgeries.

A medical procedure, specifically mentioned in relation to claims and coverage limits.

Intra Operative Neuro Monitoring (IONM)
A medical procedure, specifically mentioned in relation to claims and coverage limits.

Sum Insured
The total amount covered by the insurance policy.

Stem Cell Therapy
A medical treatment, specifically mentioned in relation to coverage.

Hematopoietic stem cells
A type of stem cell used in Stem Cell Therapy.

IRDAI
IRDAI (Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India) is the regulatory body for the insurance sector in India.

Policyholder
The individual who owns the insurance policy.

Company
The insurance provider, United India Insurance Company Limited.

TPA
Third Party Administrator, an entity that processes claims on behalf of the insurance company.

Insured Person
The individual covered by the insurance policy.

Network Hospital
Hospitals that have an agreement with the TPA or Company for cashless treatment.

PPN hospital
Preferred Provider Network hospital, a type of network hospital.

Chennai
The location of the Registered Office of United India Insurance Company Limited.

U93090TN1938GOI000108
Corporate Identity Number of United India Insurance Company Limited.

24 Whites Road
Address of the Registered Office of United India Insurance Company Limited in Chennai.

India
The country where the policy covers medical/surgical treatment.

Section 80-D
Section of the Income Tax Act under which tax rebates are available.

Income Tax rules
Rules governing income tax in India.

Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996
The legal framework for arbitration in India.

Arbitration and Conciliation (Amendment) Act, 2015
Amendment to the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996.
